__how_to_fill: HOW TO FILL IN PRICES: for each service below, set "price" to the final display string, e.g. "$250" or "$250 USD". Leave "price" as an empty string until Boston Pain Center confirms the fee — the site will show 'Price to be confirmed' instead of a fake number. Do NOT invent prices as final.
